name: desktop-pet
description: A desktop pet and little companion on the Windows desktop, always on top and in front of borderless games: a cardboard box or one of twelve figures (cat, dog, fox, bunny, hamster, owl, penguin, frog, axolotl, dragon, robot, ghost; cat, dog and bunny in nine coats). It says in a speech bubble what Claude is doing and sums up each answer; Claude's questions, Next Steps' suggestions and reply options are buttons in the bubble, and with typing on a hotkey opens a box to answer without leaving the game. A click on the pet shows the last answer in short; an unanswered bubble shrinks to one line. Optionally one pet per active session, each with its own figure and a name tag, asleep while its prompt cache is cold; it warns before the cache goes cold, and its menu keeps the cache warm (1 h, 3 h, always, off). Other mods at the pet: a command Blast Radius holds, a task from Human in the Loop (done or an option with one click) and the CI Watch result come up in the bubble, and stand in short beside its name. Built once with the C# compiler that ships with Windows and signed when a signing script is there. /pet shows it, /pet cat calico picks a figure, /pet stop sends it off.
